# JotJSON operator monitoring

First-look dashboard for app health, performance, auth, API, and quotas. See `docs/telemetry.md` for KQL conventions and the full event catalog. Environment: __ENVIRONMENT_NAME__.

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where tostring(customDimensions.messageId) == 'app.unhandled'
| summarize exceptions = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart

exceptions
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where tostring(customDimensions.messageId) == 'boot.failed'
| summarize exceptions = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart

exceptions
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize exceptions = count(), latest = max(timestamp) by outerType = tostring(outerType), innermostType = tostring(innermostType)
| order by exceptions desc
| take 10

customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where name == 'app.boot'
| summarize sessions = count() by bin(timestamp, 1d), version = tostring(customDimensions.version)
| render barchart with (kind=stacked)

customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == 'webVitals'
| summarize lcp_p75 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements['lcpMs']), 75), inp_p75 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements['inpMs']), 75), cls_p75 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements['cls']), 75) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart

customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name in ('parse.slow', 'tree.build.slow', 'tree.render.slow', 'tree.expand.slow')
| summarize events = count() by name
| order by events desc

customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name in ('auth.tokenAccepted', 'auth.tokenRejected')
| summarize events = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), name
| render timechart

customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == 'auth.tokenRejected'
| summarize rejections = count() by reason = tostring(customDimensions.reason)
| order by rejections desc

customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == 'access.forbidden'
| summarize forbidden = count() by resource = tostring(customDimensions.resource)
| order by forbidden desc

requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| extend series = strcat(name, ' ', tostring(resultCode))
| summarize requests = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), series
| render timechart

dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize p95_duration = percentile(duration, 95), calls = count() by name, type, target
| order by p95_duration desc
| take 20

requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize total = count(), failures = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| extend failure_rate_percent = 100.0 * todouble(failures) / todouble(total)
| project timestamp, failure_rate_percent, failures, total
| render timechart

customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(30d)
| where name == 'quota.exceeded'
| summarize quota_exceeded = count() by resource = tostring(customDimensions.resource)
| order by quota_exceeded desc

customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(30d)
| where name == 'quota.exceeded'
| extend count_value = todouble(customMeasurements.count), limit_value = todouble(customMeasurements.limit)
| summarize count_value = max(count_value), limit_value = max(limit_value) by bin(timestamp, 1d), resource = tostring(customDimensions.resource)
| extend gap = count_value - limit_value
| project timestamp, resource, count_value, limit_value, gap
| render timechart
